title: Ya baabe hawaej asghar

(1) Tere jhoole ko banaya hain waseela Maula
Aansuon se tujhe likhte Hain areeza Maula

(2) Chhe Moharram ko jo uthta Hain tumhara jhula
Muntazir rehte Hain uss din ke liye Ahl e Aza
Maangte hain yeh dua
Kar de aulaad ata
Mere Maula ke pisar ....Baab e Hawaij Asghar

(3) Girwi karte hain yoo bacchon ko tete jhule se
Doriyan baandh ke karte hain hawale tere
Hain zamaanat me teri
Matami bacchein sabhi
In pe rakhiyega nazar.....Baab e Hawaij Asghar

(4) Jo jhulati azakhanon me jhula khali

Aisi aulaad mile
Naukri teri kare
Itna ehsaan toh kar.....Baab e Hawaij Asghar
<<MINI>>
Chhote Shehzade mere, Baab e Hawaij Asghar....(2)

(5) Paayi Fitrus ne jo Shabbir ke jhule se shifa
Tera gehwara bhi karta hain zamaane ko ata
Aye Sakhi Ibne Sakhi
Chhe mahine ke Ali
Hain sakhi aap ka ghar... Baab e Hawaij Asghar
<<MINI>>
Chhote Shehzade mere, Baab e Hawaij Asghar...(2)

(6) Chahe kamsin ho magar bhai toh hota hain bharam
Sar pe behnon ke salamat rahe bhai har dam
Kijiye apna karam
Hain Sakina ki qasam
Baagh e Zahra ke shajar.... Baab e Hawaij Asghar
<<MINI>>
Chhote Shehzade mere, Baab e Hawaij Asghar...(2)

(7) Hosla humko bhi kar de wohi mushkil me ata
Azm jo tune dikhaya tha sar e Karbobala
Teer gardan pe laga To diye Ahl e jafa
Aap roye na magar....Baab e Hawaij Asghar
<<MINI>>

(8) Bakhuda Mesum o Salman aqeeda hain yahi
Apne ammu ki tarah Baab e Hawaij tum bhi
Hum tumhare naukar
Tumse maange na agar Phir bhala jaye kidhar..... Baab e Hawaij Asghar
